reason: Reviewed the relay-message change across all five surfaces. CLI readiness: every state in init --json now has a top-level message, the exact line to send the User, null when nothing is asked of them; gaps use their producer's line (pairing message, hooks user_action message, devices sub-state, unconfirmed proof) or a fixed line for denied, expired, unreachable and the no-plan gap (the shared no-plan line plus the plans page), and any other gap gets the stuck line built from detail and remedy.summary. Readiness ids, statuses, remedies and technical fields are unchanged (companion_setup_url is kept for older agents). harness-setup.md now tells agents to close a gap themselves when its remedy is a command they can run and otherwise send the gap's message exactly as written, keeps approve-link for a QR the harness cannot show, keeps scripts only for moments that are not gaps, and says to fall back to remedy.summary in plain words with an older CLI. SKILL.md and harness-codex.md point at message. Lifecycle hooks and domain terms are unchanged. Non-exfiltration holds: messages stay in the conversation and out of every Notification Request.
